ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.05:0.95 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity contiguous region covering >90% of the surface area. High-intensity clusters (geometric blobs) are localized at the proximal junction (peduncle area) and extreme distal tips (coordinate bounds of lobe ends).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow U-shaped depression; internal vertex angle is approximately 30-40 degrees relative to lobe midlines.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations across the entire continuous boundary; peaks display 5-15 pixel vertical displacement from the local baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted from the median notch to the distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of roughly circular high-contrast pixel groups located at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Isolated, thin, high-intensity linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) observed on the medial-ventral region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense calcified clusters (barnacles) localized on the extreme distal edges, causing significant topographical deviation from the natural fluke edge.
